objective: Make stylus pressure visibly adjustable and diagnosable; correct canvas browser-menu interference; expose more original brushes and browser-reported pen button mappings in the one cumulative app.
user_authorization: Explicit user request 7 October 2026 after U3 closure; quarantined browser preview only.
contracts: Suppress browser contextmenu only on drawing canvas/selection overlay, preserving existing two/three-finger Undo/Redo and cancellation boundaries; no document side effect from menu gesture.

New pen strokes default to clearly dynamic pressure width with adjustable minimum width and response curve plus optional pressure opacity. Mouse strokes remain full-width without invented pressure. Old stroke pixels and absent dynamics metadata remain unchanged.

Snapshot validated dynamics in each new stroke so save/reload, copy/paste, transforms and Undo retain appearance. Reject invalid/unknown dynamics fields atomically; preserve current document/work/history/render limits.

Show live browser input type, latest/min/max observed in-contact pressure, variation vs constant/unavailable report and button bitmask. Constant0.5 does not certify hardware pressure support; no raw device data transmitted.

Retain the original immutable12 brushes and add8 clearly distinct original preset options using bounded existing renderer families. All20 options reachable through existing categories; no commercial brush imports or new external assets.

Provide persistent mapping selectors for browser-reported barrel button and eraser signal: temporary Lasso, Eraser, Pan or None; defaults barrel Lasso and eraser Eraser. Nonprimary pen contact may begin mapped operation while mouse right-click never draws.

Lasso selection automatically admits Move when pen hovers/contacts within selected bounds; user can immediately drag selected strokes. Outside selected bounds remains Lasso. Pen mapping is per gesture, restores prior tool on end/cancel and never rewrites a live stroke midway.

Support pen button transitions delivered as pointermove (tip contact plus barrel/eraser bit) and reject switching within active gesture. Buttons invisible to browser cannot be mapped; no global OS/Bluetooth shortcut interception claim.

Preserve U1/U2/U3, offline/update, migration, locking, selection and performance regression on exact integration source; publish only independently accepted bytes through existing reviewed Pages workflow.
scope_out: Bluetooth shortcuts not exposed to webpage
rollback: Keep acceptedU3 ref/source unchanged; export new-dynamics boards before reverting because older preview ignores newer dynamics metadata and may reject added presetIDs.
